Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 101: October 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #101 shipped to subscribers in September 2009 (bearing the cover date of October 2009 for Issue 101). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #101 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media previews:

Forza Motorsport 3 (racing simulation)
Pro Evolution Soccer 2010 (sports simulation)
Operation Flashpoint: Dragon Rising (tactical first-person shooter)
Star Wars The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes (action-adventure)
South Park Let's Go Tower Defense Play! (Xbox Live Arcade tower defense)
Lucidity (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-platformer)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Dragon Age: Origins, and Mass Effect 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
